d:
Lok aastha ka mahaparv chhath 2026 ki taiyari jor-shor se chal rahi hai. 13 navanbar se nahay khay ki shuruaat ho rahi hai. jab bhi ko chhath ghat pahunchta hai to vahan par kaee vedinuma aakriti ya chabutra bana hota hai. kya aap jante hain ki vah kya hai? is chabutranuma aakriti ko sursuta kahte hain. manyata hai ki jaski manokamna chhathi maiya ki kripa se puri hoti vah iska nirman karata hai.
